## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 19, 2026 - Jul 27, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Alana Müller_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "first the app just stopped working. finally over a week later, after uninstall and reinstall it works again. BUT almost all my info is missing and the app is no longer user friendly. Why change what wasn't broken? Bad update."
            2. _Gabriel Tobing_, Jul 26, 2026, 1/5: "worst app ever new update causes the app to crash in a loop and unable to load data from my watch, heats up my pixel 7 pro as well due to all the crashes, had to disable the app"
            3. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
